findings.title: Repository-wide frozen engine index still identifies the superseded run_001 source
findings.detail: This audit is validly pinned by the parent execution contract to run_003 integration_source_index SHA 01a43f..., so independent run_003 identity is closed. The persistent engine_module_index.json still names the old command-queue SHA and should be advanced before unrelated future consumers discover the promoted revision without this execution context.
findings.required_action: Publish a new parent-approved frozen module index that pins the promoted run_003 source set and this report.

promotion.scope: typed DataMover control engine and adapter-control boundaries only
promotion.note: No P0/P1/P2 findings. P3 is long-term repository identity housekeeping and does not invalidate the parent-pinned run_003 audit.

implementation_evidence_audit.kernel_report: present and agrees with raw evidence
implementation_evidence_audit.module_ooc_synthesis_report: present and agrees with raw evidence
implementation_evidence_audit.claimed_same_edge_policy: abort wins over any newly formed response; an already offered stalled response remains stable and code 50 follows after its handshake; FIFO head is not popped

confirmed: three registered descriptor stages preserve typed fields and command order
descriptor priority remains 01 zero BTT, 02 DDR alignment, 03 address overflow, 04 bank, 05 offset alignment, 06 capacity
power-of-two elaboration assertions guard mask-based alignment checks
DMA valid and payload are independent of ready and stable after staging
status matching uses direction-local FIFO-head tag, keep, last and success bits
abort is first-edge sticky and cannot pop the retained FIFO head
new same-edge responses are overridden by code 50 while preserving accepted raw status diagnostics
an already offered response is not overwritten under backpressure; one pending bit serializes exactly one code-50 diagnostic behind it
reset clears pipeline-valid, fault, completion and deferred-abort state

same_edge_abort_status_adapter_done_matr.assertions: code 50 exactly once; held response stability; accepted raw status/received tag preservation; no FIFO pop; head remains active; reset-separated cases

run_002_failure_reproducer_on_run_003.result: previous simultaneous good-status/adapter-done/abort deadlock now returns held code 50

vivado_ooc.stage: synthesized out_of_context; not placed or routed
vivado_ooc.hold_exceptions: external input/output hold only; internal register-to-register hold remains timed
vivado_ooc.worst_setup_path: metadata FIFO read pointer to completion_code reset, 7 logic levels
vivado_ooc.old_run_001_path: eliminated by capture/precheck/final-validation registers; no command-input-to-descriptor-code single-cycle path

remaining_risks: WHS +0.057 ns is a valid OOC pass but must be rechecked after integration and routing.
Default bank tables remain placeholders and must be overridden to match real bank wrappers.
Vendor DataMover behavior and actual AXI traffic are external to this module evidence.
scope_and_limitations: Behavioral DDR, bank and DataMover models only in integration XSIM.
No vendor DataMover IP instantiation proof.
No placed/routed timing, board wrapper, bitstream, HWH, PYNQ or physical-board validation claim.
